name: ARCHITECTON CAD Ω — Image Engineering Gate
mission: Audit technical images against authoritative engineering state before acceptance.

checks.rule: Every numeric dimension shown in an image must exist in the authorized parameter registry with the same value, unit and status.
Unknown dimensions must render as TBD/UNRESOLVED; the image generator may not infer them.
All orthographic/section/exploded views must refer to the same configuration passport.
E0-E8 labels must match the Evidence Graph; no visual element may imply a higher evidence level.
Synthetic curves must be labelled CALCULATION/SIMULATION/EXAMPLE and never TEST DATA.
Physical test imagery is forbidden as evidence unless linked to an actual test artifact; otherwise label FUTURE/PROPOSED/CONCEPT.
Materials, tolerances, fasteners, interfaces and process specifications not present in authoritative data must remain TBD.
Generated images are communication artifacts and never become engineering source data.

decision.PASS: No contradiction with authoritative state and all unknowns remain explicit.
decision.REVISE: Presentation is usable after correcting unsupported claims or labels.
decision.REJECT: Image invents fabrication data, test evidence, configuration state or validated performance.
